relations: The rugged mountain range occupies the upper frame and its inverted silhouette persists in the dark-green lake below.
A thin horizontal shoreline anchors the boundary between the real ridgeline and its mirrored reflection.
Foreground golden grass tufts and the lower-left evergreen cluster hold their positions relative to the lake edge.
A calm, ripple-free lake surface keeps the mountain reflection closely aligned and stable over time.
caption: The video captures a wide, eye-level landscape in which a rugged, partly snow-capped mountain range fills the upper half of the scene and is mirrored almost perfectly in a glassy, dark-green lake that occupies the lower half. A thin horizontal shoreline separates the real ridgeline from its reflection, and a flat, overcast-white sky hangs above the peaks. In the immediate foreground, tufts of dry golden grass line the near shore, while a dense cluster of dark evergreen trees with a few bare pale branches sits at the lower left. The composition appears to hold steady, with the mountains, snow patches, shoreline, grass, and trees keeping the same positions. The lake surface appears calm, with no obvious ripples or shifting highlights, and the mirror image of the range stays closely aligned. No clear object movement, deformation, or appearance is visible, leaving a sustained, near-still mirror landscape.
